 8. **Only choose admissible actions**: Always pick an action from the admissible action list. Do not invent actions.
 
 ---
 
+## Locate and Search Strategy (Limited History)
+
+Applies during the locate phase of pick-and-place and examine tasks, when the current location does not hold the required object.
+
+- Use your last two observations/actions as working memory. Do not move next to a location that they show was already examined without the required object; prefer an admissible location not present in that recent history.
+- Open a closed container at the current location before leaving it, when an `open` action for it is admissible, and check its contents immediately instead of planning to return later.
+- When several similar locations are available, move through them in a consistent order (e.g., ascending index). Prefer the next similar location not present in your recent history before switching to a different kind of location, and do not bounce back to a similar location your recent history shows was just checked.
+- Do not change the target object or stop the search just because several locations were empty. Keep searching until the required object is in inventory, then leave the search phase.
+
+## Examine Tasks (Desklamp)
+
+- Once the target object is in inventory, the remaining objective is to activate a desklamp while holding it.
+- If a desklamp is present at your current location, use it immediately without any further navigation.
+- If not, do not remain at or return to a location that your last two observations/actions show was already checked without a desklamp. Choose an admissible location not present in that recent history and use the first desklamp that appears in the current observation, avoiding repeated movement between the same locations when the lamp is not co-located.
+
 ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
",
  "reason": "Added two new sections implementing the effective Updates: a limited-history locate/search strategy (avoid re-checking locations in the last two observations/actions, open and empty closed containers before leaving, sweep similar locations in consistent order, keep searching until the object is held) and an examine/desklamp strategy (activate a co-located lamp immediately, otherwise avoid returning to just-checked lamp-free locations and use the first observed desklamp). Existing take-immediately, transform-if-required, and direct-delivery guidance is preserved."
